verdict.rationale: Runloop documents suspend and resume for Devboxes: you can pause a sandbox to save state and costs, then resume "exactly where you left off" (docs-27). A dedicated tutorial shows suspending a devbox, waiting for PR feedback and resuming (docs-55), and idle and shutdown behavior is configurable (docs-64). Snapshots separately preserve disk state (docs-4). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that in-memory or process state survives suspend/resume (snapshots are described as disk-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
